description: `down` on a project whose `.multiverse/passdown.state` already reads `wrapped`, with a non-empty `PASSDOWN.md` behind it, never re-prompts the Nexus and closes the workspace, exiting 0 (card `20261116-b-f0612d` Lane B). `down`/`up` are a Rust-only surface with no Python analogue; this is a stateful fake Herdr lifecycle scenario (herdr_seed), --impl rust only.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.nexus-seat]
kind = "claude"
config_dir_var = "CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR"
config_dir = "{{DIR:claude-home}}"
pool = "claude:test"
interactive = true
command = "claude-interactive"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"
